name: framework-explainable-ast-match-diagnostics
instr:
Goravel cannot explain why AST matching or mutation fails. Add deterministic diagnostics for absent, partial, ambiguous, retried, and conflicting rewrites without changing established behavior.

Every primitive matcher must preserve its boolean result and explain its own node-type or value mismatch. Positional, nested, alternative, and equality matchers must add ordered child-path evidence without pointer identities. `MatchPath(Steps)`, `MatchEvidence(Path, Matched, Reason)`, `MatchAttempt(MatchedSteps, Evidence)`, and `MatchReport(Outcome, MatchedSteps, CandidateCount, Attempts)` from `github.com/goravel/framework/contracts/packages/match` describe the outcome, furthest prefix, candidate count, and ordered attempts. `Named` from `github.com/goravel/framework/packages/match` labels meaningful steps in composed recipes without changing supported source matches.

`packages/modify.GoFile(file string)` returns a `GoFile` whose diagnostics observe source without applying actions or writing files. Report ordered candidates, the furthest completed prefix, and multiple complete matches. Preserve both FindOrCreate attempts, distinguishing the initial miss, creation failure, successful retry, and retry miss.

`MutationDiagnostic(Match, Actions)` and `DiagnosticError(Report, Cause)` from `github.com/goravel/framework/contracts/packages/modify` retain action evidence, reports, and causes. Diagnose matched actions as applicable, satisfied, or conflicting before mutation. Use named framewo
